summary: Keep mission revision evaluation in one read snapshot.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. Previously recorded mission outcomes are not rewritten.

schema.detail: No stored field, schema, checkpoint or digest format changes.

rules.detail: Read the mission run header, steps and pinned definition from one SQLite snapshot so a concurrent revision cutover cannot combine an old generation header with cancelled predecessor steps and prematurely select cleanup. No checkpoint or fleet admission rule changes.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire, CLI or declaration format change. Nested readers use the existing snapshot helper.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the existing normal binary update procedure.

manual.detail: No data conversion or additional operator action.

recovery.detail: Ordinary binary rollback remains available with unchanged stored formats.
